from __future__ import annotations

import os
from dataclasses import replace

import pytest

from llm_router import Provider
from llm_router._internal.config import build_default_config
from llm_router._internal.runtime.limiter import KeyResolver

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_CREDENTIAL_RESOLUTION[revision==1]")
def test_automatic_key_rotation_order_and_preferences(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    env_a = "MOCK_ENV_A"
    env_b = "MOCK_ENV_B"
    env_c = "MOCK_ENV_C"
    value = "configured_value"

    for env_name in list(os.environ):
        if "GOOGLE" in env_name:
            monkeypatch.delenv(env_name, raising=False)

    monkeypatch.setenv(env_a, value)
    monkeypatch.setenv(env_b, value)
    monkeypatch.setenv(env_c, value)

    config = build_default_config()
    provider = Provider.GOOGLE
    spec = config.catalog.providers[provider]
    env_mapping = {1: env_a, 2: env_b, 3: env_c}
    custom_spec = replace(spec, api_key_env_vars=env_mapping)
    custom_catalog = replace(
        config.catalog,
        providers={**config.catalog.providers, provider: custom_spec},
    )
    custom_config = replace(config, catalog=custom_catalog)

    target_mode = "auto"
    resolver = KeyResolver(custom_config)
    first = resolver.resolve(provider=provider, key_id=target_mode)
    second = resolver.resolve(provider=provider, key_id=target_mode)
    third = resolver.resolve(provider=provider, key_id=target_mode)
    fourth = resolver.resolve(provider=provider, key_id=target_mode)
    assert [first.key_id, second.key_id, third.key_id, fourth.key_id] == [
        1,
        2,
        3,
        1,
    ]

    preferred_resolver = KeyResolver(custom_config)
    pref_first = preferred_resolver.resolve(
        provider=provider,
        key_id=target_mode,
        preferred_key_ids={2, 3},
    )
    pref_second = preferred_resolver.resolve(
        provider=provider,
        key_id=target_mode,
        preferred_key_ids={2, 3},
    )
    assert (pref_first.key_id, pref_second.key_id) == (2, 3)
